text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words as plain text, NLP allows machines to grasp meaning, context, and even emotion. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, it enables instant translation between languages, making communication across borders much easier. It also performs sentiment analysis, which detects whether a customer review is positive, negative, or neutral. Furthermore, NLP is the brain behind chatbots that answer questions on websites. By teaching machines to interpret our words, NLP is making human-computer interaction more natural and useful in daily life.
